ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central region and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field across the central and anterior fluke regions. Black pigmentation forms a repetitive series of vertical, parallel 'comb-like' extensions from the trailing edge inward. The distal tips are solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a deep vertical recession into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with irregular jagged peaks and valleys (5-15 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing boundary, particularly pronounced near the notch and tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve originating at the median notch, transitioning into a sharp upward convex sweep toward the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of textured, high-contrast tan and white circular pixel groups (barnacles) are visible on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, dark vertical linear marks (rake marks) originating at the trailing edge and extending several centimeters into the white ventral pigmentation field on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the trailing edge boundary and significant barnacle colonization on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'piano-key' or 'comb' pigmentation pattern where black vertical stripes alternate with the white ventral field along the trailing edge.
